title: Measuring the Inconsistency of Large Language Models in Preferential Ranking

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating asymmetry and transitivity by prompting LLMs with binary comparisons where the sequence of options is reversed (e.g., 'compare A and B' vs. 'compare B and A') to calculate an asymmetry score.

Comparing model preference accuracies and ranking similarities across different multiple-choice label token sets, specifically substituting Alphabetic labels (A, B, C, D) with Arabic numerals and Roman numerals.
